Lakshya Sen wins Hylo Open Title for the second time; Full Highlights
 Lakshya Sen sealed a brilliant campaign at the Hylo Open 2026 final, defeating Jonatan Christie in straight games to lift the coveted Super 500 trophy.
 Updated : Nov 01, 2026 22:35 IST

 W elcome to Sportstar’s highlights of the Hylo Open 2026 final between Lakshya Sen from India and and Line Jonatan Christie from Indonesia. 
 Lakshya clinched his second Hylo Open title with a stellar performance, defeating Christie in straight games.
 Match overview: 
 Date: November 1, 2026
 Venue: Saarlandhalle, Germany
 Final Score: 21-17, 21-10
 Key Updates
 Match Report: Lakshya rules the roost
 November 01, 2026 21:51 
 Match Report: Lakshya rules the roost
 Lakshya Sen wins Hylo Open 2026 final, beats Jonatan Christie in straight games
 Lakshya Sen beat Jonatan Christie in straight games to win the Hypo Open 2026 Men’s Singles final at the at the Saarlandhalle in Saarbrücken, Germany, on Sunday.
 November 01, 2026 21:39 
 GOLD IN SAARBRUCKEN!
 It is all over! Lakshya Sen has sealed a sensational victory, closing out the final in straight games to conquer the Hylo Open 2026 and lift the BWF Super 500 trophy in style!
 Score: 21-10
 November 01, 2026 21:36 
 Two Points Away!
 Lakshya Sen is motoring toward the finish line, keeping Jonatan Christie at arm’s length as he enters the final stretch of the second game.
 Score : 19-10
 November 01, 2026 21:35 
 Close to the title
 Lakshya is just a step away from the title, maintaining his composure and keeping Jonatan Christie pinned back as the second game hurtles toward a thrilling finish.
 Score: 17-10
 November 01, 2026 21:33 
 Clearing the hurdles!
 Lakshya is displaying exceptional court coverage, neutralizing Christie’s attacks with disciplined defense and extending his advantage as the second game heats up.
 Score: 14-8
 November 01, 2026 21:32 
 Keeping the game solid
 Lakshya continues to dictate the shot placement and tempo coming out of the mid-game break, using sharp clears and tight net control to keep Jonatan Christie under constant pressure.
 Score: 12-8
 November 01, 2026 21:30 
 Sen's Stranglehold!
 Lakshya is keeping his foot firmly on the accelerator, utilizing sharp cross-court angles to keep Jonatan Christie on the defensive and inching closer to the finish line.
 Score: 11-7
 November 01, 2026 21:29 
 Lakshya on fire !
 Lakshya is finding his rhythm in the second game, pinning Christie deep with relentless pace and extending his lead as he marches toward the finish line.
 Score: 6-10
 November 01, 2026 21:28 
 Lakshya adds pressue on Christie
 Lakshya Sen is building a strong cushion in the second game, capitalizing on a sequence of unforced errors from Jonatan Christie.
 Score: 5-8
 November 01, 2026 21:26 
 Christie fights back
 Jonatan Christie has come out firing in the second game, trying to break down Lakshya’s court defense. Lakshya is digging deep, keeping rallies alive and looking for openings to counter-attack as this high-stakes battle intensifies.
 Score: 4-6
 November 01, 2026 21:24 
 Lakshya Looks to press advantage
 With the opening game safely in his pocket, Lakshya Sen has stepped back onto the court for second game. Jonatan Christie is regrouping and looking to change the tempo to force a decider, making this early phase crucial for the Indian shuttler.
 Score: 5-2
 November 01, 2026 21:23 
 Lakshya dominates
 What a start to the final! Lakshya Sen has successfully translated his high-tempo strategy into points, holding off a late charge from Jonatan Christie to lock down the first game with composure and sharp net play.
 Score: 4-1
 November 01, 2026 21:22 
 Christie crashes in the start
 Lakshya forced Christie in the second game between wider an net drops, holding his lead constantly.
 Score: 3-0
 November 01, 2026 21:18 
 Lakshya seals the First Game
 Lakshya holds his nerve in a tense finish to the first game, fending off a late surge from Christie to draw first win in the final.
 Score: 21-17
 November 01, 2026 21:17 
 Lakshya Strikes First!
 The intensity has ramped up as Jonatan Christie finds some rhythm, narrowing the gap with a flurry of sharp cross-court smashes. However, Lakshya Sen is holding his ground with exceptional court coverage, matching pace and refusing to let the Indonesian seize the momentum.
 Score : 16-18
 November 01, 2026 21:16 
 Second Smash
 Lakshya Sen is displaying brilliant court coverage and disciplined defense against top seed Jonatan Christie in the men’s singles title clash
 Score: 14-18
 November 01, 2026 21:15 
 The missed challenge 
 Lakshya challenged an expected wider shot at the back but missed the challenege straight away to Jonatan
 Score: 12-18
 November 01, 2026 21:13 
 Lakshya's back-back banger shots
 Lakshya sends Christie back-back shots but snapped to alnd a net drop shot to make christie lose his grip.
 Score: 15-10
 November 01, 2026 21:08 
 Lakshya takes the First Game 
 Lakshya Sen and Jonatan Christie trade blistering smashes from the baseline, scrambling across the court to keep the rallies alive in a fierce display of speed.
 Score: 11-9
 November 01, 2026 21:07 
 Shuttlers Tug of Battle 
 Jonatan Christie and Lakshya Sen lock horns in a brutal, high-tempo exchange of cross-court drives, fighting tooth and nail for every single point as the momentum swings back and forth. 
 Score: Christie leads 9-8
 November 01, 2026 21:05 
 Lakshya's Lightning Strike 
 Lakshya Sen explodes off the mark with a lightning-fast sequence, pinning Jonatan Christie to the deep backhand corner before dropping a deceptive, silky-smooth crosscourt net shot that catches his opponent completely wrong-footed.
 Score: 6-8
 November 01, 2026 21:04 
 Unpredictable wide shot struggle
 Jonatan struggled with wide shots as it become an advantage to Lakshya
 Score: 8-4
 November 01, 2026 21:03 
 Lakshya leads
 Lakshya Sen is locked in deep rallies with Jonatan Christie on court, trading high clears to probe for weaknesses before snapping a quick, sharp drop shot into the forecourt.
 Score: 5-4
 November 01, 2026 21:01 
 Epic Court Warfare
 Lakshya Sen and Jonatan Christie lock horns in a relentless exchange of fast-paced, flat drives, trading body blows from mid-court. Lakshya snaps a sudden, venomous crosscourt flick to test Christie’s reflexes, but the Indonesian stays rock-solid to block it back into play. 
 Score: 3-3
 November 01, 2026 21:00 
 High Intensity Rallies
 Jonatan Christie and Lakshya Sen trade rapid, flat lifts before Christie tries to catch Sen off guard with a sharp crosscourt flick. Sen reads the trajectory instantly, exploding toward the tramlines to smash the shuttle deep into the opponent’s forecourt. 
 Score: Christie leads 2-1 now.
 November 01, 2026 20:59 
 First Game begins!
 Jonatan Christie looks to dictate terms from the back court, sending a deep, high clear toward the baseline. Lakshya Sen reads it cleanly, shifting back smoothly before unleashing a sharp, precise drop shot that clips the tape and dies in the forecourt.
 November 01, 2026 20:53 
 Players arrive on court!
 Lakshya Sen and Jonatan Christie step onto the court as the crowd in the indoor arena erupts in applause.
 November 01, 2026 19:43 
 Match to begin shortly
 Both Lakshya Sen and Jonatan Christie have had quite interesting pathways to the summit clash, which will begin very shortly. Stay tuned into this space for everything that happens on the court in Germany in the Men’s Singles final.
 November 01, 2026 19:24 
 Full list of matches between Lakshya Sen and Jonatan Christie
 2025 — All England Open — round of 16 — Winner: Lakshya Sen — Score: 21–13, 21–10
 2024 — Olympic Games — group stage — Winner: Lakshya Sen — Score: 21–18, 21–12
 2024 — Thomas & Uber Cup Finals — Group Stage — Winner: Jonatan Christie — Score: 21–18, 16–21, 21–17
 2024 — All England Open — semi-finals — Winner: Jonatan Christie — Score: 21–12, 10–21, 21–15
 2023 — Japan Open — semi-finals — Winner: Jonatan Christie — Score: 21–15, 13–21, 21–16
 2023 — Indonesia Masters — quarter-finals — Winner: Jonatan Christie — Score: 15–21, 21–10, 21–13
 November 01, 2026 19:15 
 Lakshya Sen vs Jonatan Christie H2H:
 Jonatan Christie holds a narrow 4-3 edge against his Indian opponent. The last time the two met was at the All England Open last year, when Lakshya ended up winning the round-of-16 match in straight games with a score of 21-13, 21-10.
 November 01, 2026 19:14 
 How did Jonatan Christie reach the Hylo Open 2026?
 Jonatan Christie carved out a steady path to the final, opening his campaign with a straight-game victory in the early rounds. 
 He secured a hard-fought win against fellow top contender Anders Antonsen in the semifinals after Antonsen was forced to retire mid-match, booking his ticket to the title clash.
 Full list of Jonatan Christie’s results at Hylo Open 2026: 
 Round of 32: Defeated William Bøgebjerg (DEN) – 21-18, 21-16
 Round of 16: Defeated Minoru Koga (JPN) – 21-14, 13-21, 21-18
 Quarterfinals: Defeated Kodai Naraoka (JPN) – 21-8, 18-21, 21-11
 Semifinals: Defeated Anders Antonsen (DEN) – 21-18, 16-13 (Retired)
 November 01, 2026 19:01 
 How did Lakshya Sen reach the Hylo Open 2026?
 Lakshya powered through the early rounds and overcame a tricky quarterfinal test against Finland’s Kalle Koljonen in three hard-fought games. 
 He followed that up with a commanding straight-game performance against France’s Toma Junior Popov in the semifinals to book his place in the title clash. 
 Full list of Lakshya’s results at Hylo Open 2026 
 Round of 32: Defeated Joakim Oldorff (FIN) – 16-21, 21-9, 21-13
 Round of 16: Defeated Kiran George (IND) – 21-15, 18-21, 21-12
 Quarterfinals: Defeated Kalle Koljonen (FIN) – 14-21, 21-17, 21-13
 Semifinals: Defeated Toma Junior Popov (FRA) – 21-17, 21-13
 November 01, 2026 18:56 
 Match Preview
 India’s Lakshya Sen will look to cap off a stellar run by capturing the Hylo Open 2026 Super 500 title when he takes on Indonesia’s fourth seed Jonatan Christie.
 This marks Lakshya’s second major final appearance of the season (following his run to the All England Open final earlier in the year), giving India a shot at a memorable double triumph in Saarbrücken alongside P.V. Sindhu.
